newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves 7.75 bln rupees foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: India approves 7.75 bln rupees foreign investment.

text.p: The Indian Industry Ministry on Thursday approved 61 foreign direct proposals worth 7.75 billion rupees, a ministry statement said.
* A 4.4 billion rupee ($123 million) investment by Britco Foods Co Beverages Ltd, a wholly owned unit of U.S. soft drinks maker Coca-Cola Co.
A Coca-Cola official in the Indian capital said the investment was for a plant in Pune, in the western state of Maharashtra, and would primarily be used in making cans and plastic bottles.
* A 400 million rupee investment by Britain's Siebe Plc to set up a wholly owned unit for manufacturing, engineering and project management.
* An $8 million investment by Bechtel Corp of the United States to set up a wholly owned design, engineering and procurement subsidiary to provide export services.
* A 250 million rupee investment by Air Liquide India Holding Pvt Ltd, a unit of Air Liquide of France, for the manufacture and distribution of industrial gases.
* A 200 million rupee investment by Air Liquide India Holding Pvt Ltd in a wholly owned unit to manufacture cyrogenic grade nitrogen.
* A $5 million investment by Swiss Bank Corp of Hong Kong in a non-banking financial company.
* A $3.75 million investment by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Securities for a 75 percent stake in a Bombay unit offering security brokerage and related activities.
* A $2.5 million investment by Morgan Grenfell Asia in securities and related activities.
* A 140 million rupee investment by Vintage Cards and Creation in greeting cards and stationary in Goa state.
* A 52.5 million rupee investment by Pirelli Cavi Spa of Italy in a wholly owned subsidiary in Bombay for cables and accessories.
* A $1 million investment by Sodexho Restauration ET Services of France, a unit of Sodexho SA, to provide management services for business, industry, hospitals and other social institutions.
* A 32 million rupee investment by Sandoz Ltd in a wholly owned subsdiary for lactobionic acid, calcibronat and other drugs.
